text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At last, the autumn Tenno Sho is upon us. Biwa Hayahide watches from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the race, Narita Brian exchanges a few words with Oguri Cap, who says she can't lose because she's racing for the people back in her hometown, Kasamatsu.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both make their way to the track, preparing to give the race everything they have.
